rule.name: SpringNoErrorLeak
rule.message: Log the exception and return a ProblemDetail with a fixed detail from this @ExceptionHandler. The message or stack trace of a generic, JDK or persistence exception exposes internals; messages of your own exception types are fine.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $logged := function($node) { exists($node/ancestor::MethodCall[*[1][ pmd-java:typeIs('org.slf4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.commons.logging.Log') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.logging.Logger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System$Logger')]]) } return //MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler')]] //*[let $handler := ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1], $names := $handler/FormalParameters/FormalParameter[ClassType[ pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Exception') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.Throwable') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.RuntimeException') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.IllegalArgumentException') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.IllegalStateException') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.NullPointerException') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.IOException') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.io.UncheckedIOException') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.dao.DataAccessException') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.transaction.TransactionException') or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.PersistenceException') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.PersistenceException')) or pmd-java:typeIs('java.sql.SQLException')]]/VariableId/@Name, $exception := function($node) { exists($node[self::VariableAccess[@Name = $names] or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('getCause', 'getRootCause', 'getMostSpecificCause')]/*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $names]]]) } return (self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('getStackTrace', 'printStackTrace')] or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('getMessage', 'getLocalizedMessage', 'toString')][$exception(*[1])] or self::InfixExpression[@Operator = '+'][*[$exception(.)]] or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('valueOf', 'toString', 'format', 'formatted')][ArgumentList/*[$exception(.)]]) and not($logged(.)) and (let $local := ancestor::VariableDeclarator[parent::LocalVariableDeclaration][1]/VariableId/@Name return empty($local) or exists($handler//VariableAccess[@Name = $local][not($logged(.))]))]
